title: 文件缓存反序列化失败
body:
(第一次提交issues,不知能否用中文,抱歉,本人学历低微,不具备外语能力)
- 当站点访问频率高的时候就容易出现这种情况,我的环境信息如下:
- 系统:CentOS6.4(其实windows下调试时也偶尔会发生)
- yii版本:yii2.0.3
- PHP: PHP5.4.34
- webserver: apache2.2.29

**以下是回溯:**

```
    exception 'yii\base\ErrorException' with message 'unserialize(): Error at offset 20480 of 20480 bytes' in /yii/caching/FileCache.php:36
    Stack trace:
    #0 [internal function]: yii\base\ErrorHandler->handleError(8, 'unserialize(): ...', '/data/www/myweb...', 36, Array)

    #3 /vendor/yiisoft/yii2/web/UrlManager.php(154): yii\caching\Cache->set('yii\\web\\UrlMana...', Array)

    #14 {main}
```
# 

于是我将yii\caching\FileCache的setValue做了一下修改以进行调查,首先原始代码是这样的:

``` php
    protected function setValue($key, $value, $duration)
    {
        $cacheFile = $this->getCacheFile($key);
        if ($this->directoryLevel > 0) {
            @FileHelper::createDirectory(dirname($cacheFile), $this->dirMode, true);
        }
        if (@file_put_contents($cacheFile, $value, LOCK_EX) !== false) {
            if ($this->fileMode !== null) {
                @chmod($cacheFile, $this->fileMode);
            }
            if ($duration <= 0) {
                $duration = 31536000; // 1 year
            }

            return @touch($cacheFile, $duration + time());
        } else {
            return false;
        }
    }
```

我进行修改后的代码是这样的:

``` php
    protected function setValue($key, $value, $duration) {
        $cacheFile = $this->getCacheFile($key);
        if ($this->directoryLevel > 0) {
            @FileHelper::createDirectory(dirname($cacheFile), $this->dirMode, true);
        }

        $putSize = @file_put_contents($cacheFile, $value, LOCK_EX);
        if ($putSize !== false) {
            if ($this->fileMode !== null) {
                @chmod($cacheFile, $this->fileMode);
            }
            if ($duration <= 0) {
                $duration = 31536000; // 1 year
            }


            if(YII_ENV_PROD){
                error_reporting(0);
                $content = file_get_contents($cacheFile);
                $r = unserialize($content);
                if(!$r){   //这个时候我看过$content,要么是空字符串,要么是一个不完整的序列化结果,通常都是这样,不完整的时候是被截断的字符串
                    if(!file_exists('unserialize_error')){
                        mkdir('unserialize_error');
                    }
                    $fileSize = filesize($cacheFile);
                    $valueSize = strlen($value);
                    $contentSize = strlen($content);
                    $time = date('Y-m-d_H_i_s');
                    file_put_contents(Yii::getAlias("@webroot/unserialize_error/ss_$time-putSize_$putSize-fileSize_$fileSize-valueSize_$valueSize-contentSize_$contentSize.kxk"), '');
                    error_reporting(-1);
                    unserialize($content);   //触发exception写日志
                }
            }

            return @touch($cacheFile, $duration + time());
        } else {
            return false;
        }
    }
```
